graph.title: Golden Staff Guardians (7306)

new_part_types.name: Motorbike chassis (dark grey, forks and swingarm)

notes: Part-to-piece mapping is inferred from inventory icons (page 22); the shapes of several new pieces (e.g. 4550017, 4523773, 4538780, 4210702, 4211106) are best guesses.

Piece-count check (L1) is not a real shortfall: in the booklet's parts-page picture, 4112982 is listed once as 3x, 4509897 once as 1x, and 4529672 once as 1x. The page's text layer repeats those entries, so a text count gives 6/2/2. The graph uses exactly the visible counts (3/1/1), and every piece shown is used in the build (4112982 three times: tower brick rows; one base plate; one pair of minifig legs).

Two separate groups (L3) is correct: the booklet builds two separate models, the motorbike with rider Jake (steps 1-5) and the Golden Staff pyramid tower (steps 1-17), which are never fastened together (they only sit side by side in the final picture on page 19). The two mummy minifigs are linked to the tower base only by contact since they stand beside it.

Which tower bricks stack on which exact studs is approximated from isometric pictures. To satisfy the single-use port rule, new part types have enough numbered stud ports (4509897 base plate studs 1-10, 4112982 studs 1-4, ramp 4211106 two anti-studs). On catalogue plate lego-4565320 only one stud and one anti-stud exist, so the extra stackings onto it use null ports.
Tyre/rim join uses a pin/pin-hole port pair to represent the tyre stretched over the rim (modelling choice).
Headlight: one 4539097 plate with two 3005740 round plates on the bike front; the other 4539097 is the rear plate in the rear sub-assembly (page 6).

Rear sub-assembly (page 6): hinge plate 4521187 + 4579354 with red round 3005741, two clip plates 4550017, dark red plate; clipped to the chassis in step 4. The rifle and dynamite are assumed to clip onto the rear clip plate and each other (step 5).
The pole 4566927 (with gold round plate 4523159 on its end) slides in the technic-brick hole as a lever under the golden staff 4610762, which stands on the blue 2x3 plate stud (steps 16-17).
